September 7, 2026

To the resident or property manager
414 W San Antonio St
Marfa, TX 79843

Hello from a neighbor,

Someone who lives nearby noticed an outdoor light at this address and wanted to pass along some friendly information. This is not a complaint, nothing is being reported to anyone, and there is nothing you need to answer.

No specific detail was recorded; a neighbor simply wanted to share this information with the households nearby.

Outdoor lighting does real work. It helps people find steps and doorways, it supports safety and accessibility, and it can matter a great deal to how safe someone feels at home. A neighbor walking past has no way of knowing what a particular light is for, so nothing here is a judgment about whether yours is needed.

The reason for writing is light pollution, which DarkSky International defines as the human-made alteration of outdoor light levels from those occurring naturally. When light escapes upward or sideways instead of landing where it is useful, it adds to the glow above a town, spills onto neighboring property, and disrupts animals that depend on real darkness. By DarkSky's estimate, about 80 percent of the world's population now lives under sky glow. The hopeful part is that light pollution is one of the few kinds of pollution that reverses the moment its cause changes: turn a light down, and the sky above you is darker that same night.

Thank you for reading this far. Whatever you decide is entirely up to you, and a light that turns out to be needed is a light that is doing its job. Even considering the question is appreciated.

With warm regards,
A neighbor, by way of Why Is This Light On?
